plugins.description: Bandeja de soporte de WhatsApp: mapea cada conversacion a un proyecto, define hasta donde puede actuar el agente en cada una, y abre las tarjetas por contenido del mensaje. Se vincula escaneando un codigo QR y mantiene su propia conexion con WhatsApp: guarda lo que llega en un almacen local que el agente consulta, y contesta por esa misma conexion sin abrir ni enfocar ninguna ventana. Ya no depende de la app de escritorio de macOS ni de una pestana de WhatsApp Web.

Judges what your agents are about to run, before they run it, and stays out of the way otherwise: npm test and rm -rf node_modules pass without a word, while gh pr merge, terraform apply and git push --force stop and ask. The judgement comes from Jev (TypeSafe) in a few hundred milliseconds rather than a large model reasoning about your shell, and a set of local rules catches force pushes, recursive deletes from / or $HOME, dropped tables and curl | bash in about a millisecond with no network and no API key at all. How strict it is depends on where you are: the destination catalog is built from the worktrees Orca already knows about, so a client's repository is judged more carefully than your own tooling. Verified on macOS; Windows and Linux are implemented but untested.
